calendar.matters:
Notice And Special Motion To Strike Plaintiff'S Complaint As Strategic Lawsuit Against Public Participation (Code Of Civ. Proc. 425.16)
Off Calendar Aug-24-2026 Text Ruling
MINI MINUTES: DEFENDANT THE REGENTS OF THE UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA's Special Motion To Strike Plaintiff'S Complaint As Strategic Lawsuit Against Public Participation (Code Of Civ. Proc. 425.16).

No appearance was made by any Party, Counsel, or Interested Person. The court adopts its tentative ruling as follows: Defendant The Regents of the University of California's anti-SLAPP motion to strike both causes of action in the complaint filed by plaintiff Jaejune Bae is granted as to both causes of action and the Regents are awarded reasonable attorneys' fees of $3,530 against Bae.

See Word minutes for complete ruling.

A proposed order has been submitted.

Judge: Harold E. Kahn (ret.) Clerk: R. Woods. Not Reported. (302/HEK)
